summary: Wooden Madison County lookout on Swain Mountain, about 8 miles south of Eureka Springs; nearing completion in May 1940 with CCC labour; listed as removed.

facts.design: Wooden tower about 100 feet high with an enclosed cabin at the top (1940 survey description)
facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no source describes what remains at the site today.
facts.agency: Arkansas Forest Service (named in a 1940 survey description)

events.note: Nearing completion in late May 1940 and being built by the Huntsville CCC camp, per the Madison County Journal as quoted on Forest Lookouts; the completion date is not confirmed

notes_for_editor: One compiled page, Forest Lookouts, which quotes a May 30, 1940 Madison County Journal item and reproduces a 1940 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description (PID GF0873). The CCC attribution and the nearly-finished status rest on the 1940 newspaper alone. No removal date, no current site description and no staffing or access source was found after two web searches and the cached pages. The record height of 30.5 m matches the 100 ft in the 1940 description; no correction proposed. The agency name comes from the 1940 survey wording and is not confirmed by a later source. Worth checking the NGS datasheet GF0873 and the original Journal item if they can be reached.
